div.p: Questions, missing access and specific approvals for this workspace.

main.p: Action approvals apply once to the shown tool arguments. They do not expand permissions or budgets. Budget changes require explicit new limits and separate confirmation. Recipient and cost notes come from the agent; check the actual arguments. External costs are not automatically verified.
